messages:
Maria (AE): Quick heads-up — Stratigent Health wants a 3-week POC on Hosted API. They asked for a temporary per-token rate during the POC: $0.0006/gen-token (our list is $0.0012), with a $2,000 minimum charge for the POC period. Need deal-desk + any security/legal flags.
Ben (Deal Desk): Can you paste expected token volumes and timeline? Need to run numbers.
Maria (AE): Timeline: start 2025-11-10, duration 3 weeks. They estimate ~3M tokens/week (mostly gen), so ~9M tokens total.
Ravi (SE): Security note — they said no PHI will be sent but want a no-logging option for POC and data residency assurances. For hosted api we can offer a short-term retention override but Legal/EngSec must sign off.
Karen (RevOps): We can model this as a temporary POC tier in billing: 50% off up to 10M tokens with a $2k min. But approving $0.0006/token is below our floor — Ben will need to OK an exception. Also need explicit min charge line on the order form.
Ben (Deal Desk): I can provisionally approve a one-off POC override if CS and RevOps add the minimums and Legal approves the DPA/inbound logging change. Approval conditional on non-recurring clause and auto-revert to public pricing after POC.
Olivia (CSM): CSM confirmed customer will only send test data (no PHI). They want contractual assurance for no-logs during the POC window. I'll capture that requirement.
PricingBot: Auto-note — published gen rate: $0.0012/token. Proposed = $0.0006/token (-50%). System flag: below allowed hosted floor of $0.0008/token. Manual approval required from Deal Desk.
Maria (AE): Example rate plan they'd like: ```
RatePlan {
  tier: "poc_custom",
  rate_per_token: 0.0006,
  min_monthly: 2000,
  cap_tokens: 10000000,
  duration_days: 21
}
```
Ravi (SE): Technical mitigation: we can enable transient ingest masking and disable request logging for that API key; infra would need to ensure logs are redacted at ingress. I'll loop in eng-security if Legal asks for SOC2 proof.
Ben (Deal Desk): Ok — conditional approval from me: approve 0.0006/token for 21 days if (1) RevOps adds $2k min and billing item in SFDC, (2) Legal signs DPA addendum for retention/no-logs, (3) CSM confirms no PHI and signs off. I need those items in writing by EOD tomorrow.
Karen (RevOps): I can update SFDC and prepare the invoice line. Maria, send me the customer billing contact + PO template.
Olivia (CSM): I'll get the customer's billing contact and confirm the no-PHI statement in writing.
Maria (AE): Sending PO + customer statement now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Ben (Deal Desk): Noted, will finalize once Karen + Legal confirm.
Maria (AE): Small follow-up — customer asked if we can guarantee the POC rate won't appear in their public invoice as a permanent tier. We'll include a sentence: "POC pricing is temporary, non-recurring, and will revert to standard pricing after the POC end date."
Ravi (SE): If eng-security needs to validate the masking toggle, I'll provide the minimal infra playbook.
Olivia (CSM): Customer also requested an onboarding call next week — I'll set it after we get approvals.
Maria (AE): Cool, circling back once Legal replies.
